## Core trade chain: legacy step -> PostgreSQL stage step

| legacy | PG stage | class | note |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET `/api/customers` | GET `/api/pg-stage/cinema-trade/{kind}` | READ | kind=partners |
| POST `/api/customers` | POST `/api/pg-stage/cinema-trade/partners` | ADAPT | partner upsert (version column) |
| PUT `/api/customers/{customer_id}` | POST `/api/pg-stage/cinema-trade/partners` | ADAPT | same upsert, optimistic version |
| GET `/api/quotes` | GET `/api/pg-stage/cinema-trade/{kind}` | READ | kind=quotes (+quote-items) |
| GET `/api/quotes/{quote_id}` | GET `/api/pg-stage/cinema-trade/{kind}` | READ | no get-by-id route: filter the list or add one |
| POST `/api/quotes` | POST `/api/pg-stage/cinema-trade/quotes` | ADAPT | line items, VAT mode |
| PUT `/api/quotes/{quote_id}` | PUT `/api/pg-stage/cinema-trade/quotes/{quote_id}` | ADAPT | content guard triggers apply |
| POST `/api/quotes/{quote_id}/status` | POST `/api/pg-stage/cinema-trade/quotes/{quote_id}/transition` | ADAPT | transition table cinema_pg_transitions (22 rows) decides which moves are legal |
| GET `/api/orders` | GET `/api/pg-stage/cinema-trade/{kind}` | READ | kind=orders (+order-items) |
| GET `/api/orders/{order_id}` | GET `/api/pg-stage/cinema-trade/{kind}` | READ | no get-by-id route |
| POST `/api/orders/from-quote` | POST `/api/pg-stage/cinema-trade/orders` | ADAPT | quote must be in an approvable state |
| PUT `/api/orders/{order_id}` | - | GAP | PG order columns are guarded; edit semantics undefined |
| POST `/api/orders/{order_id}/acknowledge` | - | GAP | no acknowledge step in PG |
| POST `/api/orders/{order_id}/status` | - | GAP | PG order status is driven by deliveries, not set directly |
| POST `/api/invoices/from-order` | - | GAP | PG chain is order -> delivery -> confirm -> statement -> confirm -> invoice; legacy jumps straight to invoice |
| POST `/api/automation/statements/from-order` | POST `/api/pg-stage/cinema-trade/deliveries/{delivery_id}/statements` | GAP | PG statements are built from a confirmed delivery, not from an order |
| GET `/api/invoices` | GET `/api/pg-stage/cinema-trade/{kind}` | READ | kind=invoices |
| GET `/api/invoices/{invoice_id}` | GET `/api/pg-stage/cinema-trade/{kind}` | READ | no get-by-id route |
| GET `/api/invoices/{invoice_id}/payments` | GET `/api/pg-stage/cinema-trade/{kind}` | READ | kind=payments (+payment-reversals) |
| POST `/api/invoices/{invoice_id}/payments` | POST `/api/pg-stage/cinema-trade/invoices/{invoice_id}/payments` | ADAPT | invoice must be confirmed first |
| POST `/api/invoices/{invoice_id}/payments/{payment_id}/reverse` | POST `/api/pg-stage/cinema-trade/payments/{payment_id}/reverse` | ADAPT | path loses the invoice id |
| GET `/api/invoices/{invoice_id}/adjustments` | - | GAP | complex settlement has no PG tables |
| POST `/api/invoices/{invoice_id}/adjustments` | - | GAP | complex settlement has no PG tables |
| POST `/api/invoices/{invoice_id}/adjustments/{adjustment_id}/decision` | - | GAP | complex settlement has no PG tables |
